WITH account_order_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    o.account_id,
    COUNT(*) as order_count
  FROM `order` o
  GROUP BY o.account_id
),
avg_orders_per_account AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_count
  FROM account_order_counts
)
SELECT 
  aoc.account_id,
  d.A3 as region,
  aoc.order_count,
  aoc.order_count - ao.avg_count as difference
FROM account_order_counts aoc
JOIN account a ON aoc.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
CROSS JOIN avg_orders_per_account ao
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
